findings.passage: Free and fair elections are the bedrock of our democracy. Requiring photo id, verifying citizenship, cleaning up the voter rolls, and stopping ballot harvesting would be a great start. Absentee ballots should be carefully scrutinized and should adhere to strict guidelines to ensure identity. Allow election observers complete access to the election process. Prohibit early vote counting and same day voter registration. Provide state legislatures with legal standing to ensure enforcement of election laws.
findings.note: iVoterGuide questionnaire answer for the 2022 primary (State Rep., Dist. 78) to 'What laws would you propose to change present voting practices?'. Names photo ID, citizenship verification, voter-roll cleanup, strict identity rules for absentee ballots, and bans on early counting and same-day registration.
